info.name: Microsoft Graph Word Body Drive Items API

description.content:
REST API for interacting with Word documents in Microsoft 365 and OneDrive via the Microsoft Graph unified endpoint. Provides operations for file management, content access, sharing, permissions, versioning, and document metadata for DriveItem resources.
